name: Section opener
purpose: Orient the learner at a genuine structural transition.
useWhen: A major section genuinely begins — not every subtopic.
avoidWhen: Used for every heading change, which flattens its meaning.
platformNote: Rise: native banner or the approved custom section opener.

name: Explanation
purpose: Introduce and explain a concept with clear hierarchy and readable density.
useWhen: Building core knowledge the learner needs before acting on it.
avoidWhen: The content is really a single retainable point — use Key message instead.
platformNote: Rise: native image-and-text is preferred; split card only where the image adds real meaning.

name: Key message
purpose: Isolate the one point a learner should retain.
useWhen: One legal threshold, definition or critical reminder.
avoidWhen: Routine supporting detail, or more than one message in a single panel.
platformNote: One to three sentences. Use ordinary body text with a subheading as the fallback.

name: Legislation or authority
purpose: Separate source requirements from plain-English interpretation.
useWhen: A specific Act, regulation or section underpins a requirement.
avoidWhen: A general policy statement with no legislative source — use a standard content panel.
platformNote: Always name the instrument precisely and keep the plain-English summary visibly separate from the quoted source.

name: Scenario stage
purpose: Present new context or evidence from the decision-maker's perspective.
useWhen: A discrete context, update, observation or piece of evidence within a running scenario.
avoidWhen: General explanation unrelated to the scenario — use a split card or standard panel.
platformNote: Keep one stable visual environment and decision-maker perspective across a whole scenario.

name: Decision point
purpose: Require a realistic professional judgement and reveal the reasoning behind it.
useWhen: A genuine professional juncture with credible distractors and consequential feedback.
avoidWhen: An obvious answer with implausible distractors — use a native knowledge check for simple recall instead.
platformNote: Feedback must explain why an option is appropriate, not only whether it was selected.

name: Feedback
purpose: Explain why a choice is appropriate, not only whether it is correct.
useWhen: Immediately after every decision, revealed in place.
avoidWhen: As a generic correct/incorrect message with no reasoning.
platformNote: Announce revealed feedback appropriately; place it immediately after the action that caused it.

name: Process
purpose: Present actions or stages in a meaningful, genuinely ordered sequence.
useWhen: Order is real and matters to the outcome.
avoidWhen: The steps are not truly sequential — a card grid or list communicates it more honestly.
platformNote: Use numbering only where the number carries meaning.

name: Comparison
purpose: Clarify differences between roles, responses or alternatives.
useWhen: Two related audiences or positions need to be held side by side, with parallel categories.
avoidWhen: More than a handful of items — use a card grid or table instead.
platformNote: Keep categories parallel and the differences explicit; this is the pattern behind the shared Role split component — course-specific one-off comparisons (see Governance) should be migrated to it.

name: Reflection
purpose: Prompt considered application without adding unnecessary interaction.
useWhen: A short self-assessment or reflective prompt genuinely aids transfer.
avoidWhen: As a large, decorative treatment — the legacy Editorial reflection component exists only for backwards compatibility.
platformNote: Prefer native statement/reflection blocks or a compact approved panel; use the self-assessment table only where a structured rating genuinely helps.

name: Resource
purpose: Explain what a linked item is, why it matters and what will happen when it opens.
useWhen: A supplementary document or external guidance needs context before the click.
avoidWhen: Essential learning is available only through the external link — bring it into the course itself.
platformNote: Name the resource and why it matters; a native attachment or text link is the fallback for lighter cases.

name: Section summary
purpose: Close a major section and reinforce the intended learning.
useWhen: The end of a major section, before a genuine transition.
platformNote: Three to five concise points; the dark/footer band gives it a deliberate structural close.
